newsitem.title: USA: GM to form dealer issues task force.
newsitem.headline: GM to form dealer issues task force.

text.p: In a move to better address the concerns of its dealers, General Motors Corp on Thursday said it will form a special task force made up of sales, marketing and other corporate staff members.

GM said it named William Farmer, general sales & service manager for the Oldsmobile Division, to head the task force, which will investigate, analyze and develop recommendations on long-term franchise and dealer network strategies.
Farmer and the task force will report to Ronald Zarrella, GM vice president of North American sales, service and marketing.
The task force will consist of representatives from GM's Dealer Network, Investment and Development group; Vehicle Sales, Service and Marketing group; and other corporate and NAO staffs.
Replacing Farmer, who was in his Oldsmobile position nearly two years, will be William Powell, GM's general manager of dealer network investment and development.
The appointments are effective on March 1, 1997.
